research_objective: Test grounded-language acquisition through adaptive instruction and whether teaching cost changes with experience.

experimental_arms.configuration: current Ninereeds configuration at the common campaign ancestor
the same common ancestor with the separately frozen BDH-CQ adaptations

comparison_invariants: common ancestor before the configuration intervention
same source images, crops, highlights, and application material
same intended Points and pedagogical rules
same declared intervention menu and provisional budgets
same controller, teacher, verifier, randomness, and adjudication policy except for declared configuration differences
adaptive_path_rule: Arms may traverse different branches and teaching amounts; that difference is an outcome.

planning_horizon.method: Freeze the next defensible lesson, run it, inspect the new learner state, then choose the next step.
planning_horizon.learning_rule: Record predicted dosage beside observed dosage so planning priors can improve without becoming hidden assumptions.

immutable_script: controlled-practice and Kreuz und Quer pools

topic_point_contract.topic: Coherent environment and incidental structure that is neither scored nor claimed as known.
topic_point_contract.point: Deliberately taught frontier; all other scored language must satisfy prerequisite policy.
topic_point_contract.scene_metadata: Retain entity, state, action, spatial, and co-occurrence relations without exposing them as labels.
topic_point_contract.effect_boundary: Topic coherence may help, do nothing, or interfere. Treat each as a result; never assume a world model.

controlled_counterfactual_scene_family.example: the same cat and couch in the same living room: cat on, under, in front of, or behind the couch
controlled_counterfactual_scene_family.production: Prefer Flux editing from one reviewed canonical scene; verify every variant independently.
controlled_counterfactual_scene_family.boundary: Later transfer uses different entities and scenes to prevent template learning.

default_lesson_shape: present a four-item Point set with unambiguous crops or highlights
run negative controlled practice without appending an affirmative correction
only then open mixed Kreuz und Quer practice across the four established forms
adapt presentation or practice per item within the frozen rules
introduce additional four-item sets when prerequisites and evidence allow
apply the material in a grounded picture story
finish when the declared acquisition rule is satisfied or the bounded path terminates

early_form_dependency.rule: Mix a form only after its separate block. Early feedback must not introduce a later form.

dosage_axes.pack_size: Compare values such as four versus seven items rather than treating four as universal.
dosage_axes.train_more: Add bounded curriculum breadth or new valid examples.
dosage_axes.train_longer: Extend varied mixed practice without replaying identical questions.
dosage_axes.replay_lesson: Repeat the frozen lesson as an epoch and measure gain, plateau, retention, and fresh transfer.
dosage_axes.rule: Vary one dosage axis at a time when causal interpretation matters.

state_rules: Failures attach to items, not automatically to the set or lesson.
Early meaningful failures replay the four-item presentation for contrast.
Acquired items leave intensive rotation but remain in mixed practice at reduced frequency.
Record raw responses separately from failure episodes so retry loops cannot manufacture leeches.
Move leeches into varied later contexts instead of unlimited same-lesson repetition.
Treat persistent problems as research objects with material, tokenization, interference, projector, representation, and architecture hypotheses.

provisional_parameters.status: must be frozen by the campaign contract and revised only through evidence-bearing amendments

longitudinal_evaluation.ordinary_stream: Every lesson trace is continuous behavioral and teaching-efficiency evidence; do not add a redundant immediate post-lesson test.
longitudinal_evaluation.repetition_lessons: After a provisional block of eight lessons, sample one four-question exercise per source lesson and measure retention and bounded reacquisition.
longitudinal_evaluation.deep_boundaries: At provisional 40-lesson boundaries, run the frozen controlled-boundary suite, MRI or internal scans, retention and reacquisition summaries, failure analysis, and paired arm comparisons.

primary_measures: eventual acquisition under the bounded lesson contract
Train More and Train Longer interventions
arm_stopping_rule: Dropping an arm requires a deliberate campaign-level decision based on a substantial, stable, compounding difference across accumulated evidence, not one lesson or a short streak.
non_assumptions: coherent scenes create a world model
MRI proximity has human semantic meaning
four items is the optimal pack size
whole-lesson replay produces durable rather than template-specific gains
